doctors.bio: Dr. Phani Krishna holds an MDS from SRM and a fellowship of the International Congress of Oral Implantologists (FICOI, USA). Prosthodontics is the branch of dentistry that restores and replaces teeth, so his day-to-day work centres on implants, crowns, bridges and dentures. Besides seeing patients at Dent Plus, he is a professor at Sibar Institute of Dental Sciences. At the clinic he plans implant and denture cases with you step by step, explaining the options that suit your mouth, your health and your budget before anything begins.

Dr. Deepthi holds an MDS and works at Dent Plus as a consultant prosthodontist and implantologist, restoring worn, broken and missing teeth with crowns, bridges, dentures and implants. She also sees patients for routine check-ups, fillings and cleaning, and for children's dental visits, so a whole family can be looked after by the same dental team.

doctors.specialization: Consultant Family Physician & Paediatrician (Children's health, Family medicine)
doctors.bio: Dr. Venugopal Rao holds an MBBS and has worked as a senior resident in paediatrics. At Dent Plus he is the consulting family physician and paediatrician. Parents bring babies and children to him for fevers, coughs, tummy upsets and growth questions; adults see him for everyday illness and check-ups. When a child or adult needs tests or a hospital, he explains why and where to go.

doctors.specialization: Consultant Family Physician & Ophthalmologist (Eye care, Family medicine)
doctors.bio: Dr. Padmaja Rani holds an MBBS and a Diploma in Ophthalmology (D.O.). She is the clinic's consulting family physician and eye doctor. She checks vision and eye health, sees patients with red, watery, itchy or strained eyes, and arranges referral to a surgical eye centre when an operation such as cataract surgery is needed. She also sees adults for general medical problems.

faqs.question: Can I book for more than one family member?
faqs.answer: Yes. Book each person separately, online or by phone. If you mention it at reception, the team will try to keep the appointments close together.

faqs.question: Which doctor should I book if I'm not sure?
faqs.answer: Choose the department that fits best and pick the general option. The doctor will see you and, if another of our doctors is better placed, arrange that.

faqs.question: Do I need to bring anything?
faqs.answer: Carry your current medicine strips or a written list, recent blood reports or X-rays, and your spectacles if you are coming for your eyes. For children, bring the vaccination card.

faqs.question: How does online booking work?
faqs.answer: Pick a department or doctor, then a free time. We text a six-digit code to your mobile to confirm it is you, and the appointment is booked straight into the clinic's system.

faqs.question: What does a consultation cost?
faqs.answer: Consultation fees are being confirmed by the clinic. Treatment costs depend on what the doctor finds and are explained before anything starts.
